segments.speaker: athena
segments.caption: Then send Hermes, the guide, the slayer of Argus, across the water to Ogygia at once. Let him stand before the nymph Calypso with our fixed decree: hard-enduring Odysseus goes home.
segments.delivery: decisive planner moving from speech into immediate departure

segments.speaker: athena
segments.caption: And I go to Ithaca myself, to breathe strength into his son. I will set Telemachus on his feet, send him to call the Achaeans to assembly, and then across the sea to Pylos and Sparta for news of his father, so the boy may win a name among men.
segments.delivery: decisive planner moving from speech into immediate departure

segments.caption: So the gods split the work of return: one command would free the father, another would awaken the son.
segments.delivery: frame the action without replacing character agency

segments.speaker: athena
segments.caption: Athena fastens the gold sandals, closes her hand around the spear, and drops from Olympus.
segments.delivery: decisive planner moving from speech into immediate departure
